title: Foreign firmware (recognized non-LightPlayer)
board: S3 (or classic) — WLED has no C6 build

setup.describe: Fetch a WLED release image (the foreign firmware a real user is most likely to have). Set WLED_URL to the asset for your board from https://github.com/wled/WLED/releases — e.g. the ESP32-S3 4MB build. Pinned by URL on purpose: a moving 'latest' would silently change what this fixture captured.
Flash it at 0x0 (WLED release binaries are FULL images: bootloader + partitions + app). This overwrites LightPlayer entirely — that is the point.

manual: EXPECTED TO FAIL TODAY: the card should read as replaceable foreign firmware, but the classifier's safe-to-replace list holds exactly one entry (the Seeed XIAO C6 factory demo), so WLED will most likely land Unresponsive. File the finding — the captured RX lines ARE the evidence needed to teach the classifier WLED's boot signature.
